music: Existing theme, sparse and low; let the fires and the wind carry the quiet. No tribal-drum cliché, no horror stings on the Shanidar chapter.
mix: Near -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP. Effects below aligned narration.

new_assets.prompt: Thin steady wind over frozen open grassland at night, dry grass hiss, no howling or whistling, no animals.
A small wood fire crackling gently in a quiet enclosed space, occasional soft pop. No roaring blaze.
One dry branch laid onto embers, a brief crackle and settle. No whoosh.
Two light taps of stone on stone, dry and close. No metallic ring.
Calm lake edge, very small waves on mud, reeds moving, a distant horse snort. No gulls, no motor.
A stone tool scraping along a wooden shaft, three slow strokes. No saw or sandpaper.
A stone scraper drawn across a stretched hide, two slow strokes, dull and soft. No fabric tear.
Quiet cave mouth: faint dry wind at the opening, a drip somewhere behind, distant birds outside. No echoey music.
A pointed stone tool pressed through hide onto bone, four small sharp taps in rhythm. No hammering.
A small handful of small ivory beads poured onto hide, soft dry rattle. No glass or coins.
Grain ground on a flat stone with a handstone, slow rhythmic rasp. No mill or metal.
Dry grass bundles laid down and pressed by hand, two soft rustles. No wind.
Shallow lake water disturbed once, a small splash and drip, as a fish is lifted. No swimmer.
A heavy bone set down against other bones, one dull knock. No wooden clack.
Three slow footsteps on frozen grass and thin snow, crisp crunch. No boots on gravel.
Inside a brush hut: a tiny fire ticking, branches creaking slightly, wind muffled outside. No voices.

acquisition: Use suitable licensed existing assets only after listening. Quote any missing asset within the future episode allowance; nothing is generated during development.
